value:
Hi there! I'd be happy to help you understand your room rent limit.

Based on your Family Shield Plus policy, your room rent is covered up to **1% of your Sum Insured**, which works out to **Rs. 5,000 per day** (Clause C3.2, page 4).

A couple of important things to keep in mind:
- If you choose a room that costs more than Rs. 5,000 per day, your insurer will apply a **pro-rata deduction**. This means they will reduce your total claim proportionally, except for pharmacy, consumables, implants, and diagnostics.
- ICU expenses are covered separately at **2% of your Sum Insured**, which is **Rs. 10,000 per day** (Clause C3.2, page 4).

Would you like help with anything else regarding your policy?
